title: 遍历装配体树并批量导出各零件为 STEP 格式

provenance.source_ref: COE Forum Topic: Batch Export Assembly Components to STEP
provenance.author: COE Community

description: 遍历当前激活 Product 文档下的所有子部件，获取对应 PartDocument 并批量导出为 .stp 文件。
code:
import os
import win32com.client

def export_assembly_parts_to_step(output_dir: str):
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    product_doc = catia.ActiveDocument
    root_product = product_doc.Product
    
    for i in range(1, root_product.Products.Count + 1):
        sub_product = root_product.Products.Item(i)
        # 获取零件真实关联的 PartDocument
        try:
            part_doc = sub_product.ReferenceProduct.Parent
            part_number = sub_product.PartNumber
            file_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f'{part_number}.stp')
            part_doc.ExportData(file_path, 'stp')
            print(f'Exported: {file_path}')
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'Failed to export {sub_product.Name}: {e}')

title: 提取装配体所有组件 BOM 属性与质量明细

provenance.source_ref: Eng-Tips Forum: CATIA V5 Automation - Inertia & BOM Extraction
provenance.author: Eng-Tips CAD Forum

description: 遍历装配体提取每个零件的 PartNumber、Definition、Revision 以及通过 Inertia 分析得到的质量和重心。
code:
import win32com.client

def extract_assembly_bom():
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    root_product = catia.ActiveDocument.Product
    bom_data = []
    
    for i in range(1, root_product.Products.Count + 1):
        prod = root_product.Products.Item(i)
        item = {
            'part_number': prod.PartNumber,
            'definition': prod.Definition,
            'revision': prod.Revision,
            'description_ref': prod.DescriptionRef
        }
        # 尝试通过 Inertias 提取质量
        try:
            inertia = prod.GetTechnologicalObject('Inertia')
            item['mass_kg'] = round(inertia.Mass, 4)
        except Exception:
            item['mass_kg'] = None
        bom_data.append(item)
    return bom_data

title: 根据草图名称规则批量创建 Pad 凸台特征
description: 在当前 Part 的 Main Body 中查找所有以指定前缀命名的 Sketch，批量生成指定高度的 Pad 凸台。
code:
import win32com.client

def batch_create_pads(height_mm: float = 20.0, sketch_prefix: str = 'Base_'):
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    part = catia.ActiveDocument.Part
    body = part.MainBody
    shape_factory = part.ShapeFactory
    
    for i in range(1, body.Sketches.Count + 1):
        sketch = body.Sketches.Item(i)
        if sketch.Name.startswith(sketch_prefix):
            pad = shape_factory.AddNewPad(sketch, height_mm)
            pad.FirstLimit.Dimension.Value = height_mm
            print(f'Created Pad for sketch: {sketch.Name}')
    part.Update()

title: 计算当前零件在主坐标系下的最小外接包围盒 (Bounding Box)

provenance.source_ref: COE Forum Thread #26500: GetPointsEnvelope Bounding Box Measurement
provenance.author: COE CAD Developers

description: 通过 Measurable 接口或者 SPAWorkbench 分析整个 Part 的三维极值坐标 (Xmin, Xmax, Ymin, Ymax, Zmin, Zmax) 计算包围盒尺寸。
code:
import win32com.client

def get_part_bounding_box():
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    part_doc = catia.ActiveDocument
    spa = part_doc.GetWorkbench('SPAWorkbench')
    part = part_doc.Part
    
    # 对主几何体进行测量分析
    measurable = spa.GetMeasurable(part.MainBody)
    # 提取包围盒三维尺寸
    # 注意：win32com 返回的 safe_array 可以通过 list 直接解构
    coord_points = [0.0] * 6
    # 返回格式: (Xmin, Ymin, Zmin, Xmax, Ymax, Zmax)
    try:
        res = measurable.GetPointsEnvelope(coord_points)
        dx = res[3] - res[0]
        dy = res[4] - res[1]
        dz = res[5] - res[2]
        return {'dx': dx, 'dy': dy, 'dz': dz, 'bbox_raw': res}
    except Exception as e:
        return {'error': str(e)}

title: 从指定曲面提取所有外部边界线并测量总长度

provenance.source_ref: Eng-Tips Forums: GSD Surface Boundary Extraction & Measurement
provenance.author: Eng-Tips CAD Forum

description: 使用 HybridShapeFactory 创建 Boundary / Extract 特征提取曲面边界并测量其展开周长。
code:
import win32com.client

def extract_and_measure_surface_boundary(surface_feature_name: str):
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    part = catia.ActiveDocument.Part
    hs_factory = part.HybridShapeFactory
    spa = catia.ActiveDocument.GetWorkbench('SPAWorkbench')
    
    # 查找目标曲面特征
    hb = part.HybridBodies.Item(1)
    surface = hb.HybridShapes.Item(surface_feature_name)
    
    # 创建边界特征 (1 = Complete boundary)
    boundary = hs_factory.AddNewBoundary(1, part.CreateReferenceFromObject(surface))
    hb.AppendHybridShape(boundary)
    part.Update()
    
    # 测量边界总长度
    measurable = spa.GetMeasurable(part.CreateReferenceFromObject(boundary))
    length_mm = measurable.Length
    print(f'Boundary Length: {length_mm:.2f} mm')
    return length_mm

title: 自动读取 3D 零件属性并回填更新工程图标题栏 (Title Block)
description: 在激活的工程图中遍历背景图框视图（Background View），查找指定名称的 Text 对象并填充 3D 模型的 PartNumber 和 Drawing Title。
code:
import win32com.client

def update_drawing_title_block(part_number: str, designer_name: str, title: str):
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    drawing_doc = catia.ActiveDocument
    sheets = drawing_doc.Sheets
    active_sheet = sheets.ActiveSheet
    
    # 背景图层视图索引通常为 2 (Background View)
    views = active_sheet.Views
    bg_view = views.Item(2)
    texts = bg_view.Texts
    
    for i in range(1, texts.Count + 1):
        txt = texts.Item(i)
        if txt.Name == 'TitleBlock_PartNumber':
            txt.Text = part_number
        elif txt.Name == 'TitleBlock_Designer':
            txt.Text = designer_name
        elif txt.Name == 'TitleBlock_Title':
            txt.Text = title
    print('Title block updated successfully.')

title: 无头批处理生成 Catalog (CNEXT -batch + CreateCatalogFromcsv) 彻底避开空根章节坑

provenance.source_ref: CATIA V5 User's Guide cceugbt0102 + BatchCatalog.csv + Live Kernel Verification
provenance.author: CATalyst Curated

description: 交互界面调用 Documents.Add('CatalogDocument') 会插入无法删除的默认空根章节(Chapter.1/章节.1)导致生成结果视觉空白。唯一正解是通过 CNEXT.exe -batch -macro 无头模式运行 CreateCatalogFromcsv；CSV 需 GBK+CRLF+分号分隔，父 CHAPTER 挂内部子章节时第1列与第2列必须与子章节名严格一致，支持 CATDLN:// 路径与联邦总库跨链子 .catalog，执行前严禁在同会话打开源 .CATPart 或目标 .catalog。
code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import win32com.client

def build_catalog_headless(catstart_exe: str, env_name: str, env_dir: str, csv_path: str, out_catalog: str):
    # Write GBK+CRLF semicolon-delimited CSV before invoking headless CNEXT -batch
    script_path = Path(out_catalog).with_suffix('.CATScript')
    script_body = (
        'Language="VBSCRIPT"\r\n'
        'Sub CATMain()\r\n'
        '  Dim c As Document\r\n'
        '  Set c = CATIA.Documents.Add("CatalogDocument")\r\n'
        f'  c.CreateCatalogFromcsv "{csv_path}", "{out_catalog}"\r\n'
        '  c.Close\r\n'
        'End Sub\r\n'
    )
    script_path.write_text(script_body, encoding='gbk')
    cmd = [
        catstart_exe, '-run', f'CNEXT.exe -batch -macro "{script_path}"',
        '-env', env_name, '-direnv', env_dir, '-nowindow'
    ]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)

def create_catalog_dynamic_com(csv_path: str, out_catalog: str):
    # Note: In live COM use dynamic.Dispatch to avoid gen_py base Document cast; prefer headless batch to avoid empty Chapter.1
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    doc = win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(catia.Documents.Add('CatalogDocument')._oleobj_)
    doc.CreateCatalogFromcsv(csv_path, out_catalog)
    doc.Close()

title: 无 COM SettingController 时使用 CATBatGenXMLSet / CATBatImpXMLSet 实现 .CATSettings XML 往返配置

provenance.source_ref: CATIA V5 Infrastructure Administration + CATCuiOptionEditor.CATNls + Live Roundtrip Verification
provenance.author: CATalyst Curated

description: 对于未暴露 COM SettingController 的 Tools->Options 设置（如 CatalogOption.CATSettings），可使用达索原厂 CLI 工具 CATBatGenXMLSet / CATBatImpXMLSet 导出标准 XML、修改属性后回写并二次导出验证。关键实测属性：CatalogOption 中 ResolvedComponentsMode=0 为 Standard Behavior，FavoriteCatalog 与 FavoriteCatalogDocEnv 按分号对齐（支持 CATDLN://）。注意 DLNames.CATSettings 需改用 CATSysDLExport；修改需重启 CATIA 生效。
code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import win32com.client

def roundtrip_catsettings_xml(catstart_exe: str, env_name: str, env_dir: str, out_dir: str, repo_name: str = 'CatalogOption'):
    # 1. Export .CATSettings to XML via CATBatGenXMLSet
    Path(out_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run([
        catstart_exe, '-run', f'CATBatGenXMLSet.exe "{out_dir}" {repo_name}',
        '-env', env_name, '-direnv', env_dir, '-nowindow'
    ], check=True)
    xml_file = Path(out_dir) / f'{repo_name}.xml'
    # 2. After editing XML (e.g. ResolvedComponentsMode=0, FavoriteCatalog), import back:
    subprocess.run([
        catstart_exe, '-run', f'CATBatImpXMLSet.exe "{xml_file}"',
        '-env', env_name, '-direnv', env_dir, '-nowindow'
    ], check=True)
    # 3. For COM-exposed repositories, SettingControllers remains available via win32com
    _ = win32com.client.Dispatch
    return xml_file

title: 外部 .txt 设计表强制 Windows CRLF 防静默失步与动态 AddAssociation 参数绑定
description: 外部文本 DesignTable (.txt) 若采用 Unix LF 换行，调用 dt.Synchronize() 不会抛异常但会静默忽略新行（ConfigurationsNb 不更新）。写入时必须显式指定 encoding='gbk', newline='\r\n' 并在 Synchronize 后校验 ConfigurationsNb；新增列关联参数需经 dynamic.Dispatch(dt._oleobj_).AddAssociation(param, col_name)。
code:
import win32com.client

def write_and_sync_design_table(txt_path: str, rows: list[list[str]], dt_com, new_param=None, new_col: str = ''):
    # Mandatory Windows CRLF + GBK to prevent silent row drop during Synchronize()
    with open(txt_path, 'w', encoding='gbk', newline='\r\n') as f:
        for r in rows:
            f.write('\t'.join(str(x) for x in r) + '\n')

    dt_dyn = win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(dt_com._oleobj_)
    dt_dyn.Synchronize()
    expected_configs = len(rows) - 1
    assert dt_dyn.ConfigurationsNb == expected_configs, (
        f'DesignTable silent sync mismatch: got {dt_dyn.ConfigurationsNb}, expected {expected_configs}'
    )
    if new_param is not None and new_col:
        dt_dyn.AddAssociation(new_param, new_col)

title: 隐藏知识工程内部公式/规则 (Relation.Hidden) 与设置 Product 原生源标记 (CatProductSource)

provenance.source_ref: CATIA V5 KnowledgeInterfaces + ProductStructure Live Verification
provenance.author: CATalyst Curated

description: Relation 继承自 KnowledgeObject，具有可写属性 Hidden。封装标准件模板时可保留 DesignTable 可见（通过 hasattr(rel, 'Configuration') 识别），将其余内部 Formula/Rule 的 Hidden 设为 True 隐藏于特征树同时保持 Activated=True 正常驱动；并可通过 Product.Source 设置 CatProductSource（0=Unknown, 1=Made, 2=Bought）。
code:
import win32com.client

def encapsulate_template_relations_and_source(part_doc, source_enum: int = 2):
    part = part_doc.Part
    rels = part.Relations
    for i in range(1, rels.Count + 1):
        rel = rels.Item(i)
        rel_dyn = win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(rel._oleobj_)
        # Keep DesignTable visible; hide internal formulas/rules while keeping them active
        is_dt = hasattr(rel, 'Configuration')
        rel_dyn.Hidden = not is_dt

    prod = win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch(part_doc._oleobj_).Product
    prod.Source = source_enum  # 0=Unknown, 1=Made, 2=Bought

title: Catalog 标准件三模入库选型与 PKT Document Template 实例化边界

provenance.source_ref: CATIA V5 User's Guide bascuctg0000 + cfyugpktattemplate0042/0047 + cfyugasmut1400
provenance.author: CATalyst Curated

description: 按标准件生命周期分三模入库：1) 不可改参固定成品（电机/接插件）直接普通 .CATPart 入库，装配共享只读母件；2) 纯离散规格件（螺栓/轴承）用 Unresolved Part Family + 唯一 PartNumber 列，ResolvedComponentsMode=0 时自动按 New from 生成独立件；3) 入装配后仍需改工况自由度的参数化模板（如弹簧角度/脚长）必须走 PKT Document Template + Save in catalog（GUI-only 无创建 COM API），双击填参生成全新 UUID 实例且保留内部公式与发布元素。
code:
import win32com.client

def select_catalog_storage_mode(tunable_after_insert: bool, table_driven_specs: bool) -> str:
    # Mode 3: Tunable parametric template -> PKT Document Template + Save in catalog (GUI-only creation)
    if tunable_after_insert:
        return 'PKT_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE'
    # Mode 2: Pure discrete spec table -> Unresolved Part Family (ResolvedComponentsMode=0 -> New from)
    if table_driven_specs:
        return 'UNRESOLVED_PART_FAMILY'
    # Mode 1: Fixed bought/standard part -> Standard .CATPart component (shared read-only reference)
    _ = win32com.client.Dispatch
    return 'DIRECT_COMPONENT_REFERENCE'
